item.title: Banking on Deposits That Can Leave
item.description: Post 2/4 of the No Gut Feelings Bank series. How much maturity transformation does an SA deposit base license, and is the behavioural haircut real? Franchise duration for No Gut Feelings Bank from Post 1 betas and survival: the licence is 1–7 years per rand, the haircut is zero, and the residual risk lives on the uninsured-share axis, where duration cannot see it.
